name: Spider (1 Suit)
description:
**Goal:** assemble eight complete King-to-Ace runs, each in a single suit, and move them to the foundations.

- Choose how many suits are dealt: **1 suit** (every card a spade, the gentlest), **2 suits** (spades and hearts) or **4 suits** (two full packs, the classic and the hardest).
- Tableau columns build **down in any suit**: a card lands on any card one rank higher.
- Cards move as a group only when they form a **same-suit descending run**; otherwise you move **one card at a time**. With one suit, every descending run moves together.
- Only **face-up** cards can be picked up; uncovering a face-down card flips it.
- Any card may start an empty column.
- When you're stuck, **tap the stock** to deal one card onto every column — allowed only when **no column is empty**.
- A **complete King-to-Ace run in a single suit** (all 13 cards) leaves for a foundation **on its own** the moment you finish it — there is nothing to drag.
- Your **score** starts at 500, loses one for every move and gains 100 for each run sent to the foundations.

redealWhen.reason: Deal a row only when no column is empty
